Image Cropper

Crop any image by dragging a selection box over it — with optional fixed aspect ratios — then preview and download the cropped result.

Drag on the image to select a crop area. Drag a corner handle to resize.

📖 How to use

  1. Upload your image.
  2. Drag on the preview to draw a crop box (drag corners to resize).
  3. Optionally lock an aspect ratio.
  4. Click “Crop & download” to save the cropped PNG.

❓ Frequently asked questions

Which aspect ratios are supported?

Free-form, 1:1 square, 4:3, 3:2, 16:9 and 9:16 presets. The box keeps its ratio while you resize it.

Does it work on mobile?

Yes — works with mouse and touch, so it is fully usable on phones.

Is the crop full resolution?

The crop is taken from the full-resolution original, never from the shrunken preview.

Is my image uploaded?

No — cropping happens entirely in your browser.
